description: This file defines the TitlePartHandler class, which manages the title part of content items in OrchardCore, including setting titles, validation, and caching settings.

classes.name: TitlePartHandler
classes.description: Handles operations related to TitlePart, including setting titles, validation, and caching settings for content items.

methods.name: UpdatedAsync
methods.description: Handles the update event for TitlePart, triggers title setting.

methods.name: CreatedAsync
methods.description: Handles the creation event for TitlePart, triggers title setting.

methods.name: ClonedAsync
methods.description: Handles the cloning event for TitlePart, triggers title setting.

methods.name: ValidatingAsync
methods.description: Validates the TitlePart, ensuring a title is provided if required.

methods.name: SetTitleAsync
methods.description: Sets the title of the content item based on settings and pattern.

methods.name: GetSettingsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves and caches TitlePartSettings for a given content item.
